display_information.name: ChannelGate
display_information.description: ChannelGate — run Claude Code or Codex in your Slack, sandboxed per channel.
display_information.long_description: ChannelGate brings Claude Code into Slack. Mention the bot in a channel (or just DM it) and it runs a headless Claude session inside a per-conversation sandboxed folder, with each user's own Composio token injected only into their own messages. Admins configure per-channel access, MCP servers, and skills from a local admin UI. Runs over Socket Mode against a self-hosted gateway daemon.

agent_view.agent_description: Chat with Claude Code in threads and DMs — sandboxed per channel.
